gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anek-telugu: Stentiga writes like a rolling-ball pen, spaced wide and luxurious. What stands out is how Anek Telugu, a sans with wide bowls left unsealed, gives the reading rhythm an approachable lilt.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-anuphan: Stentiga draws pencil-steady lines, spread wide for a luxurious feel. Anuphan, a sans-serif with big round bowls and curves that leave clear gaps, should carry a page of text with an unhurried pace.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-arimo: Stentiga spaces its letters out, with a rounded-wire stroke that feels refined and luxurious. But Arimo, a sans-serif with a high mean line and spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs, keeps long reading smooth.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-chivo: Stentiga looks like a bent paperclip, spread wide and luxurious. Chivo sits beneath with its lowercase packed up toward the caps and daylight through every curve, giving the heading room to stretch.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-cossette-texte: Refined and luxurious, Stentiga spreads its letters wide, with crossbars that match its stems. And Cossette Texte, with a wide-eyed lowercase e and a prominent x-height, should make longer reading feel clean and unforced.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-duru-sans: No swelling or thinning ever touches Stentiga's luxurious, spread-out line. Stentiga takes the display spotlight, while Duru Sans, with wide openings on small letters and bodies that dominate the line, does the quiet reading.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-funnel-sans: Crossbars matching the stems give Stentiga a spread-out, luxurious look. Stentiga excels at refined display moments, while Funnel Sans, a sans-serif with constant stroke widths and a pried-open e, does the clean text work.
